strings.sync.label: Cloud save: {status}
strings.sync.sheet.title: Cloud save
strings.sync.sheet.local: Your progress lives on this device. It saves to your account game once you're online.
strings.sync.sheet.synced.guest: Your progress is saved to your account game as a guest.
strings.sync.sheet.syncing: Saving your progress to your account game.
strings.sync.sheet.offline: No connection. Keep playing: your progress is saved on this device and goes to your account game when you're back online.
strings.sync.sheet.paused: Saving to your account game is paused because the server could not accept this save. Keep playing on this device; we'll try again later.
strings.sync.sheet.update: Your account game was saved by a newer version of the game. Reload to update, then saving picks back up.
strings.sync.sheet.behind: This device's game is from before your last prestige, so it can't replace your account game. Use your account game instead.
strings.sync.sheet.conflict: This device and your account game have different progress. Pick the one to keep. The other is replaced.
